root_cause: Unit tests wrote simulated dry-run state directly into production logs/published_state.json
auto_fix: Added logs_dir parameter to run_cycle() and isolated tests with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
prevention_rule: All tests must use TemporaryDirectory for logs_dir and never mutate production logs/ or data/

root_cause: Concurrent threads_affiliate.yml and reporting.yml pushed to main without rebasing first
auto_fix: Added git pull --rebase origin main before git push in both workflows
prevention_rule: Always rebase onto origin/main before pushing automated state commits in CI

root_cause: Immediate GET /{media_id}/insights after publishing can fail before Meta indexes the post
auto_fix: Wrapped collect_satellite_insights() API calls in try/except RecoverableTaskError with safe defaults
prevention_rule: Treat immediate post-publish insights fetch as best-effort so publishing never fails retroactively
